hardware.variant: Luckfox Lyra Zero W, RK3506B, populated USB radio and onboard antenna

inputs.name: Luckfox Buildroot image with AIC8800DC modules and firmware
Linux 6.1.99 diagnostic FIT
inputs.revision: Original modules, firmware and base DTB. The RAM root disables access to microSD and SPI NAND.

scenario: On the factory RAM system, observe successful kernel reads of four named files during probe of WLAN interface 2. Bring wlan0 up, then down. Unbind and bind the same WLAN interface through sysfs. Check the parent USB bus and device numbers, configuration, USB runtime power status and driver identity. Bring wlan0 up again.
expected: The two probes identify the same USB device. Both probes return success and wlan0 opens after each bind.
observed: Both probes returned success. Both interface opens succeeded. The first probe read the U02 WLAN patch, its table, the calibration program and board settings. The second probe read the patch, table and settings. The observer recorded no read of the calibration program during that probe. The parent bus and device numbers remained the same.
limits: These observations cover two probes during one Linux boot. The first probe followed a system reboot. The second followed interface close and rebind. The test kept board power on and used no USB reset command. The factory driver can reset its MAC when closing an interface.

The second file sequence is consistent with the factory driver reusing a DPD result in radio RAM. The kernel observer could not identify any of the selected call frames on this build. Only the USB probe return and file read results were measured. Individual coefficients and clock state were outside the measurement.
The test checked interface open. It did not test association, DHCP or native EmberBSD operation.
